# Source: nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max: # Adapted for wisp-design: schema condensed to 6 columns; web stacks only.

column4: flush-left rigour.

column3: prompt
column4: css_template

column3: Primary action — square corners, flat colour, neue-grotesk weight 500
column4: padding: 14px 28px; background: var(--si-fg); color: var(--si-ground); border: none; border-radius: 0; font-family: var(--si-grotesk); font-weight: 500; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: 0;
column5: ☐ AA contrast on fg ☐ no border-radius ☐ visible focus ring (offset outline 2px) ☐ 44x44 touch min

column3: Secondary — hairline border, square, neue-grotesk
column4: padding: 14px 28px; background: transparent; color: var(--si-fg); border: 1px solid var(--si-fg); border-radius: 0; font-family: var(--si-grotesk); font-weight: 500;
column5: ☐ AA contrast on border + text ☐ no rounded corners ☐ hover inverts fg/ground

column3: Display headline — neue-grotesk, flush-left, tight tracking, no display weight
column4: font-family: var(--si-grotesk); font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 5rem); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.0; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-align: left; color: var(--si-fg);
column5: ☐ line-height 0.95-1.05 ☐ flush-left (no center) ☐ weight 500 (not 700+) ☐ negative tracking for display

column3: 12-column grid — strict, gap fixed, flush-left content
column4: display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr); gap: 24px; max-width: 1280px; margin-inline: auto; padding-inline: 32px;
column5: ☐ 12-col strict ☐ no centred content blocks within grid ☐ mobile collapses to 4-col

column3: Hero — flush-left headline + sub, anchored to grid column 1-7
column4: grid-column: 1 / 8; padding-block: 120px 80px; text-align: left;
column5: ☐ flush-left (no center) ☐ headline spans cols 1-7 ☐ no decorative graphic in hero ☐ single CTA

column3: Top nav — wordmark left, links right, hairline rule below
column4: display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; align-items: center; padding: 24px 32px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--si-rule); background: var(--si-ground); font-family: var(--si-grotesk);
column5: ☐ semantic <nav> ☐ skip-link ☐ flush-left wordmark ☐ aria-current on active

column3: Nav link — neue-grotesk, no underline, hover-shifts-opacity
column4: color: var(--si-fg); font-family: var(--si-grotesk); font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 150ms;
column5: ☐ AA contrast ☐ visible focus ring ☐ hover opacity 0.65

column3: Feature card — no chrome, content-only, hairline top rule
column4: padding: 32px 0; background: transparent; border: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--si-rule); border-radius: 0;
column5: ☐ no shadow ☐ no rounded corners ☐ hairline rule only ☐ generous padding-block

column3: Text input — bottom-rule only, square, neue-grotesk
column4: padding: 10px 0; background: transparent; color: var(--si-fg); font-family: var(--si-grotesk); font-size: 16px; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--si-rule); border-radius: 0;
column5: ☐ font-size ≥16px iOS ☐ focus shifts border-bottom-color ☐ label above input ☐ AA contrast

column3: Data table — hairline rules between rows, tabular-nums, flush-left
column4: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: var(--si-grotesk); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 14px;
column5: ☐ tabular-nums on numeric cols ☐ hairline rules only ☐ no zebra-striping ☐ flush-left text

column3: Body — neue-grotesk, restrained line-height, max 65ch
column4: font-family: var(--si-grotesk); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 65ch; color: var(--si-fg);
column5: ☐ max 65ch enforced ☐ line-height 1.45-1.55 ☐ AA contrast

column3: Section divider — full-bleed hairline rule
column4: height: 1px; background: var(--si-rule); margin-block: 80px;
column5: ☐ semantic <hr> ☐ no box-shadow ☐ full bleed (no margin-inline)

column3: Metadata caption — small grotesk, single accent stripe
column4: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--si-grotesk); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--si-fg-muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
column5: ☐ AA contrast ☐ uppercase + tracking applied ☐ tracking 0.04em (not loose)

column3: Footer — grid-aligned columns, hairline top rule, neue-grotesk
column4: display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr); gap: 24px; padding: 64px 32px 48px; border-top: 1px solid var(--si-rule); background: var(--si-ground);
column5: ☐ semantic <footer> ☐ 12-col grid maintained ☐ flush-left content

column3: Status badge — square, hairline border, neue-grotesk small
column4: display: inline-flex; padding: 2px 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--si-fg); border: 1px solid var(--si-fg); border-radius: 0; font-family: var(--si-grotesk); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
column5: ☐ no rounded-pill ☐ AA contrast on border + text ☐ semantic colour and text (not colour alone)

column3: Pagination — number-only, square buttons, current bold
column4: display: flex; gap: 16px; font-family: var(--si-grotesk); font-size: 14px;
column5: ☐ aria-current on active ☐ no rounded buttons ☐ active item weight 600

column3: Section vertical rhythm — generous, grid-aligned
column4: padding-block: clamp(80px, 12vh, 160px);
column5: ☐ section padding ≥80px ☐ clamp for responsive

column3: Vertical list — flush-left, hairline rules between
column4: display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0;
column5: ☐ semantic <ul>/<li> ☐ rules between items only ☐ no bullet markers (use hairline)

column3: Modal — square card, hairline border, flush-left content
column4: padding: 48px; background: var(--si-ground); border: 1px solid var(--si-fg); border-radius: 0; max-width: 560px;
column5: ☐ focus-trap ☐ ESC closes ☐ no rounded corners ☐ flush-left content
